label: R18-CORE-SYSKILL-CUT
title: Cut the system-commit feedback path into FP TX_DONE

timing_source.path_cause: idex_valid -> live FP-to-GPR forwarding/decode -> sys_commit_ready/sys_commit -> fp_tx_kill -> fp_rsp_ready/rsp_ready -> TX_DONE D

scope: Prove and remove or locally decouple the redundant sys_commit feedback into fp_tx_kill so the current decode/system-commit network cannot drive the FP wrapper TX_DONE transition. Preserve precise system/exception/IRQ/restore kills, held response, single outstanding transaction, FP-to-GPR RAW behavior and commit order. Add invariants proving a system commit cannot coexist with an FP owner/response; do not use false paths or weaken assertions.
validation: static proof/SVA of sys_commit and FP owner mutual exclusion
TX_DONE held response under WB backpressure
FCVTZS/FCVTZU immediate GPR RAW and branch use
T-012 FP/data-MMU overlap plus IRQ-young and P7 regressions
acceptance: The RTL no longer contains a same-cycle sys_commit/decode path into fp_tx_kill or FP TX_DONE D; all real kill boundaries remain precise; no response is lost or duplicated; focused and joint regressions pass. Physical improvement is not claimed until a new post-fit STA query shows the idex_valid-to-TX_DONE cone removed or moved.
resource: Owner may edit and run only lightweight/static checks initially. All Verilator/QEMU heavy validation is released serially by the integrator; CPU<=50%, MemoryMax=16G, MemorySwapMax=0, VERILATOR_JOBS=1.
board_policy: No Quartus assembler, bitstream, JTAG, programming, power-on or board test without explicit user permission.
